name: joycraft
description: Install and update Joycraft, a skill bundle and runtime for agent-led software work, in any project

joycraft.summary: The review loop uses the tool your project already has: setup finds it per package, recommends one only for a gap and installs on your yes; agreed limits are no longer UNVERIFIED; a per-feature waiver can skip review; a broken tool holds one spec, not the queue.

scripts.build: node scripts/generate-bundled-files.mjs && node scripts/sync-skills.mjs && tsup && node scripts/release-preparation.mjs emit-descriptor

author: Maximilian Maksutovic
